\section{Capture inventory}
\label{app:inventory}

The measurements behind Chapter~4 are 354 captures recorded between 21 and
27 July 2026: 326 tap captures held in the 65 measurement sets listed below,
plus 28 single captures held at the top level of the capture directory. The
latter are the swept-sine, ringdown and noise-floor recordings used for the
linearity check of Appendix~A.2, the damping estimates of Section~4.1, and the
instrument noise floor. Each folder is one measurement
set: a single sensor position, damage location and grade, captured as five taps.
The inventory below is compiled from the capture folder structure and the session
records, and maps each set to the tables and figures it feeds.

Five taps per set is the campaign standard and holds for every set listed except
`day5\_baseline`, which has six.
Where a set is not read by any committed analysis it is marked as such: those are
day-3 pilot captures and extra replicates retained as part of the research
record.

\subsection*{The earlier four-storey campaign}

A separate set of 42 runs was recorded on 15 July 2026 on a four-storey
configuration, with the sensor at Floor~4 and a damage index that was later
abandoned. That campaign is retained in the data deposit for the record under
\texttt{superseded\_four\_storey\_campaign/}. No number in this dissertation
derives from it. The retargeting of the rig from four storeys to three, and the
reasons for it, are described in Section~3.
